x_note: ADR-0011 / report G.5 (Stage 107B). The OCI image identity model. A mutable tag is NEVER assumed to denote identical bytes across architectures: ARM64 (mist) and AMD64 (fog/cloud) require distinct platform entries. The target platform is taken from D-Continuum and must match the node's observed engine platform; a missing platform entry denies execution in required mode.

model.tag: informational only; never trusted for identity
model.index_digest: digest of the OCI image index / Docker manifest list when the reference is multi-platform; null for single-platform images
model.platforms: one entry per target platform: {os, architecture, variant, manifest_digest, config_digest}

executed_image_identity_evidence.note: The verification method must be engine-store-aware and is validated in Stage 107B. With the classic Docker image store the local image ID is the config digest; with the containerd image store the local ID can be the index or manifest digest.

open_item: The existing artifacts/catalog/chirpstack-gateway-bridge.json digest must be classified as index or platform manifest before it can be marked required-complete. Stage 107 does not modify the catalog.
